sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection P1, which 
must be performed every two years as indicated by Y5 in the title block.

This document initiated by eng. Amany Elmetwaly, tested by eng. 
 Hoda Ali, revised by quality control eng. Adel Abdelkader Elnagar at MDPE , accepted by 
 general director eng. Metwaly 
 Mahmod El-Hendawy , approved by eng. 
 Farouk Awad head sector of Talkha P.S.

This document accepted by eng.Samir Abdelgilil 
 inspection quality control general director and MPIS coordinator and eng. 
 Mahmmed Nagib head sector of quality control .

Safety 
Precautions

A 
work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with 
caution marks surrounding the work area.

Wear safety helmet, shoes, 
ear plug and gloves pairs.

sections.text: Work to be carried out

Measure 
and record the insulation of motor winding, repair if required

Clean 
the body of the motor and ventilation holes using air blower and brushes

Remove 
the motor bearing bracket.

Remove 
the rotor, avoid touch the stator end winding by the rotor.

Check 
the ball bearings, grease / lubricate or replace if needed. (bearings and grease 
must be kept free of dirt).

Clean 
motor winding using soft brushes
Reassemble the motor.

Check 
all the tightens of the power and control circuits connections.

Measure 
and record the dc resistance of motor winding.

Measure and 
record the insulation of motor winding after maintenance and befor running the 
motor.

Connect the power source to the motor.

Run the motor and check the ball bearing or roller bearing housing temperature 
 not more than 80C .
Check lubrication and alignment if temperature exceed this limit
Check vibration or noises, tighten the bolts if required

Check all protection of the motor by protection group (O.C, S.C., U.V)
